population: All 2290 catalog no-oil patches: 1939 water and 351 coast
model: Frozen SOS selected model; no retraining or parameter tuning
input: Native patch dimensions, PIL grayscale uint8 divided by 255; no resizing, cropping or contrast adjustment
decision: A patch is a false alarm if any predicted oil region is retained (score > 0); report count of retained regions and predicted oil pixel fraction
limitations: No-oil-only evaluation cannot measure oil recall or overall F1
Scene/patch dependence; do not claim independent patch confidence intervals
Different preprocessing and native scale from SOS; external domain test
No labels proving individual rain, low-wind or biogenic subtype
Report failed downloads/inferences; never silently drop them
